status: PROPOSALS ONLY: product requirements and measurements are pending

thermal.notes: 50 C is air immediately around the board, not outside an enclosure. h is an uncalibrated boundary assumption, not a label for sealed or vented boxes. All retained 3.3 V heat is placed at U3 as a sensitivity proxy. No package or enclosure heat paths, transient duty cycle, or guaranteed junction bound.

assumption_notes: These source voltages do not select a battery chemistry or approve a cutoff.
0.13 ohm for Q1 is a hot-resistance sensitivity value, not a guaranteed datasheet maximum. AO3401A specifies 85 milliohm maximum at VGS=-2.5 V and 25 C; temperature raises resistance.
0.20 ohm external resistance includes an assumed battery/cable/contact path; its heat is outside the PCB model but may remain inside the enclosure.
Amplifier 16.75 mW idle overhead is 5 V times 3.35 mA, a 25 C datasheet maximum under specified test conditions, not a full-temperature bound. The 90 percent incremental audio efficiency is assumed.
85 percent converter efficiency is a scenario value, not a guaranteed operating minimum. Selected inductors, voltage and temperature affect it.
3.3 V is rounded from the board's nominal 3.307 V. All 3.3 V load power is retained as board heat here. In the earlier report some was assigned off-board.
Speaker electrical power is outside the PCB thermal model, but heats the enclosure if the speaker is inside it. An external-ambient enclosure model must include that heat and battery/contact loss.
1.6 A continuous input is a proposed 20 percent design margin below JST PH's 2 A AWG24 specification, not a manufacturer derating rule.
